visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long dark hair lies on a light blue sofa, holding a black smartphone. Behind his head, several plush toys including Snoopy and a green bear are visible. The lighting is bright and indoor. (2) A brown paper bag with a large red 'NETFLIX' logo sits on a black and red doormat with the text 'THE UPSIDE DOWN'. A hand reaches down to lift the bag. (3) The man walks through a modern hallway holding the bag. He looks upward with a suspicious expression at two recessed ceiling lights. The hallway is brightly lit with white walls. (4) Close-up of the ceiling lights as they flicker and dim periodically. The ceiling is white with a slight texture. (5) The man reaches up towards the flickering light fixture with both hands, his body angled upwards against the white wall and near an air conditioning unit. (6) A first-person view looks into the brown paper bag, revealing a red lunchbox, a bag of 3 Musketeers candy, a can of Pringles, and a newspaper. (7) The man places a red lunchbox with a 'NETFLIX' label on a table. He unlatches the brown handles and opens the lid to reveal a waffle topped with colorful M&M candies and scrambled eggs. (8) A brief, grainy television clip shows a man in a hat looking intently. This is followed by a shot of the main character taking a large bite of the waffle. (9) A series of close-up shots show the man flipping through 'The Hawkins Post' newspaper, which contains various articles and ads themed around the show 'Stranger Things', such as 'Hellfire Club' and 'Radio Shack'. (10) The man drinks from a white mug with the 'STRANGER THINGS' logo while looking around the room cautiously as the lights continue to flicker in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A clear, two-tone electronic doorbell rings ('Ding-Dong'). No vocals or music are present yet. (2) A loud, sharp rustling sound of heavy brown paper indicates a bag being grabbed and lifted. (3) A low-frequency, eerie synthesizer pad begins, creating a suspenseful atmosphere. Soft, rhythmic footsteps on a hard floor are audible. (4) Distinct electrical buzzing and crackling sounds ('Bzzz-t') occur, synchronized with visual flickering of lights. The BGM remains tense. (5) Another series of heavy paper crinkling sounds as the bag is handled and opened. (6) Multiple plastic rustling sounds and the clatter of small objects occur as the bag's contents are explored. (7) A clear mechanical 'click' sound is heard as a lunchbox latch is opened, followed by a slight scraping of plastic. (8) The BGM shifts to a more melodic, retro-synth track with a steady pulse. (9) A loud, crisp crunching sound accompanies the man taking a bite of the waffle. (10) Rapid sounds of paper flipping and rustling occur as the newspaper pages are turned. (11) A distinct liquid swallowing or sipping sound is heard. The synthesizer music builds slightly in volume before cutting to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a creative promotional piece for a Netflix 'Stranger Things' themed delivery or experience box. It uses thematic elements from the show—such as flickering lights, the 'Upside Down' doormat, and 'Hawkins' branding—to create an immersive atmosphere for the reveal of themed snacks and merchandise.
